title: Descent of one finite projective module over a directed ring colimit
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every finite projective $A$-module $X$ [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], there are $i\in I$ and a finite projective $F(i)$-module $M$ with an isomorphism $M\otimes_{F(i)}A\cong X$, where scalar extension uses the canonical map $F(i)\to A$.

source.place: Tag 0BC7, label more-algebra-lemma-colimit-perfect, first paragraph of the proof, using Algebra Tags 05N7 and 00NX

proof.text: Finite generation and projectivity make X finitely presented by Module.finitePresentation_of_projective. Obtain i, a finitely presented M, and eM from [lem-pc-fp-preorder-colimit-model]. Choose a finite free retraction onto X using Module.Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective. The base-changed Pi.basisFun identifies the stage free module N=(F(i))^n with A^n after scalar extension.

Conjugate the splitting maps by eM and the finite free comparison isomorphism eN. Associativity and the inverse identities show their composite is the identity. Apply [lem-pc-fp-colimit-retraction] to get a stage retraction of the base-changed M from the base-changed N and its colimit comparison.

The base change of the finite free basis makes the later N finite free. Module.Projective.of_split makes its summand M projective; the retraction is surjective by LinearMap.surjective_of_comp_eq_id, so Module.Finite.of_surjective makes M finite. Compose the comparison isomorphism with eM to obtain the asserted model.
